text: A lion pride is built around related females and their offspring, with one or more resident males. Members often associate in smaller subgroups.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Smithsonian National Zoo, lion fact sheet; https://nationalzoo.si.edu/animals/lion. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: Young male lions may form coalitions with brothers or cousins after leaving their natal pride.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Smithsonian National Zoo, lion fact sheet; https://nationalzoo.si.edu/animals/lion. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: Several lions may approach prey from different directions before attacking. Females are the primary hunters in a pride, though males sometimes join.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Smithsonian National Zoo, lion fact sheet; https://nationalzoo.si.edu/animals/lion. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: A female kori bustard lays eggs in a shallow ground scrape and incubates them alone.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Smithsonian National Zoo, kori bustard fact sheet; https://nationalzoo.si.edu/animals/kori-bustard. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: American white pelicans and other colonial waterbirds nest on Yellowstone's Molly Islands, gathering many nests into a small island setting.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: National Park Service, Yellowstone bird inventory; https://www.nps.gov/yell/learn/nature/birds.htm. Consulted 2026-10-13.
